# telnyx_10dlc_campaign_accept_sharing (Action)

Accepts a 10DLC campaign that another campaign service provider shared with Telnyx, so that Telnyx numbers can be assigned to it.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `campaign_id` (String) The campaign id.
